extension.description: Super extension for Lexicon: full grammar (.lex/.lang), snippets, themes, lex toolchain commands, hover/completion/definition/symbols, CodeLens and diagnostics
config.title: Lexicon
config.lexicon.path: Path to the lex binary (bare name resolves via PATH).
config.lexicon.path.md:
Path to the `lex` binary. A bare name resolves via `PATH`.

Example:
```json
"lexicon.path": "lex"
```
config.lexicon.sdkPath: Root folder of the Lexicon SDK (used for Ctrl+Click go-to-definition into stdlib). Empty = auto-detect from the lex binary, LEXICON_HOME/LEXICON_SDK, ~/.lexicon/sdk, and common install dirs.
config.lexicon.sdkPath.md:
Root folder of the Lexicon SDK, the equivalent of Go's `GOROOT`. Ctrl+Click on a stdlib symbol (e.g. `strings::ToUpper`, `Console.writeLine`) opens its source under `<sdkPath>/lib`.

Leave empty to auto-detect from, in order: the `lex` binary location, `LEXICON_HOME` / `LEXICON_SDK` env vars, `~/.lexicon/sdk`, machine-wide install dirs (e.g. `C:\Program Files\Lexicon`), and the current workspace.

Example:
```json
"lexicon.sdkPath": "C:\\Users\\me\\.lexicon\\sdk"
```
config.lexicon.features: Comma-separated #[cfg(feature)] flags passed as --features to lex build.
config.lexicon.features.md:
Comma-separated `#[cfg(feature)]` flags forwarded to `lex build` / `check` / `vet` as `--features`.

Example:
```json
"lexicon.features": "gui"
```
config.lexicon.target: Target triple override for lex build (empty = native).
config.lexicon.target.md: Target triple override for `lex build` (empty means native).
config.lexicon.vetOnSave: Run lex vet on save and surface findings as diagnostics.
config.lexicon.vetOnSave.md: When enabled, saving a `.lex` file runs `lex vet <file>` and surfaces findings as editor diagnostics.
config.lexicon.formatOnSave.md: When enabled, saving a `.lex` file runs `lex fmt`.
config.lexicon.trace.server: Trace level for the Lexicon language client.
config.lexicon.trace.server.md: Trace level for the Lexicon language client (`off` is quietest).
config.lexicon.telemetry.enabled: Count command usage locally (never leaves the machine).
config.lexicon.telemetry.enabled.md: When enabled, command invocations are counted in memory and logged to the Lexicon output channel. No network calls are ever made.

task.command: Lex command to run (run, build, test, check, vet, lint, fmt, bench, doc, trace, debug, profile, serve, test-net, dns-check, tls-check).
task.file: File to operate on (defaults to the active file).
task.args: Extra arguments appended after the resolved command.
task.host: Host for network tasks (serve, test-net, dns-check, tls-check).
task.port: Port for network tasks (serve, test-net, dns-check, tls-check).
task.env: Extra environment variables for the task.
walkthrough.title: Get Started with Lexicon
walkthrough.description: Install lex, scaffold a project, run the demo API and its tests.
walkthrough.step1.title: Install the lex toolchain
walkthrough.step1.description: Run `lex install`, then verify with `lex --version`. If `lex` is missing, set the `lexicon.path` setting.
walkthrough.step2.title: Create a project
walkthrough.step2.description: Run the New Project command to scaffold main.lex plus .env files.
walkthrough.step3.title: Run and test
walkthrough.step3.description: Start the dev server with `lex run --watch` and run every `@Test` with `lex test`.
